text: {"label": "Reading Fluency and Comprehension Interventions", "definition": "Behavioral interventions to improve oral reading fluency and comprehension in struggling readers, including repeated reading, computer-based programs such as Headsprout, Direct Instruction, and reinforcement, for children, adults, and learners with autism or disabilities.", "distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on connected-text fluency and comprehension outcomes, unlike combined reading-and-writing literacy instruction, isolated sight-word and spelling acquisition, or math and college course performance."}
